description: Four-channel stereo performance mixer, two mono and two stereo, each with a fader, panning, an aux send, a clickless mute and a cue switch, plus two aux returns, a master level and a headphone output

params.text: Sets that channel's aux send: full to the X send turned fully left, nothing at the centre, and full to the Y send turned fully right
Places that mono channel in the stereo field
Sets the left and right balance of that stereo channel
Sets the level of that channel in the mix
Silences that channel without a click
Sends that channel to the cue bus, which feeds the CUE output and can be heard on the headphone output
Picks whether the X aux send is taken before or after each channel's fader and mute
Picks whether the Y aux send is taken before or after each channel's fader and mute
Sets the level of the headphone output
Crossfades the headphone output between the cue bus and the master mix
Sets the level of the X return in the mix
Sets the level of the Y return in the mix
Sets the level of the main outputs

inputs.text: The input to that mono channel
The left input of that stereo channel
The right input of that stereo channel; with nothing patched here that channel's left input feeds both sides
The left return from the X aux send
The left return from the Y aux send
The right return from the X aux send; with nothing patched here the left return feeds both sides
The right return from the Y aux send; with nothing patched here the left return feeds both sides
Sets the level of that channel, silent at 0V and fully open at 5V, attenuated by that channel's fader
Moves that mono channel across the stereo field, full left at -5V, centred at 0V and full right at 5V, offset by that channel's PAN knob
Sets the left and right balance of that stereo channel, full left at -5V, centred at 0V and full right at 5V, offset by that channel's BAL knob
Sets that mono channel's aux send, full to X at -5V, nothing at 0V and full to Y at 5V, offset by that channel's AUX knob

outputs.text: The X aux send, carrying every channel's send to X
The Y aux send, carrying every channel's send to Y
The cue bus, carrying every channel whose cue switch is on
The headphone output, blended between the cue bus and the master mix

notes: the REC button on each channel is panel lettering from the hardware, where it records knob moves; the plugin configures no control behind it and pressing it does nothing.
